page_title: ACM 2-2 BOL | AC Milan v Bologna 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
90+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Mike Maignan.
90+2' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+1' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) is given a yellow card.
90+1' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bologna!
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Referee Davide Massa makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bologna. Let’s see what happens!
90' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Christian Pulisic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan).
87' A substitution has been made. Rafael Leao is replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).

83' 2 - 1 Alessandro Florenzi produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) rises high to head the ball into the middle of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:1.
82' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Lorenzo De Silvestri is replaced by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna).
82' Here comes a substitution. Giovanni Fabbian is given a rest as he is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
81' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.
80' AC Milan get a corner.
79' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is flagged for offside.
74' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
74' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
73' Sam Beukema (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. That is a penalty kick for AC Milan.
70' Dangerous play by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Nikola Moro (Bologna) replaces Michel Aebischer.
67' Here's the change. Kacper Urbanski leaves the pitch and Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is replacing Yacine Adli.
60' Stefano Pioli decides to make a substitution. Olivier Giroud will be replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch so that Davide Calabria can be given a rest.
57' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Davide Massa didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
55' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the right side of the goal. Mike Maignan is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
52' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
49' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan). Davide Massa doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

45' 1 - 1 Goal! Davide Calabria produces a great pass that finds Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
44' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Yacine Adli (AC Milan) for a tough tackle.

42' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Skorupski keeps his cool to thwart him.
42' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
41' Referee Davide Massa has finally had enough of Thiago Motta and gives him a straight RED CARD!
40' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Davide Massa ignores the protests.
39' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from AC Milan is about to take a penalty kick.
37' The linesman points to the corner flag, AC Milan are going to take it.
37' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
36' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Davide Calabria (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
34' That was close! Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
32' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Davide Massa blows for a foul.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
25' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
24' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) prepares to take a corner kick.

24' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.
22' Today's referee Davide Massa rightly decides to book Rafael Leao (AC Milan) for his harsh tackle.
20' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
19' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) skips past challenges and takes a shot to the top left corner, but Lukasz Skorupski makes a brilliant save to thwart him.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Remo Freuler (Bologna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
14' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) and blew his whistle.

10' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mike Maignan pulls off an easy save.
6' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Davide Massa got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
